notes.title: Girls and Dungeons 2 Now Live on Steam!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Just a quick announcement that the sequel to the game is now live on Steam! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1096750/Girls__Dungeons_2/

Girls & Dungeons 2 features a hi-fidelity, reworked pixel graphics style and refined gameplay and features, noting feedback received on the first game. It features new areas, characters, stories, and more!

Some features include;
[list]
[*]     An estimated 11-15 hours of diving in bewitching booze - themed dungeons
[*]     Protect your maidens via classic, turn-based JRPG battle system
[*]     Mysterious and surprising 'spirit sanctuaries'; full of fierce critters and lewd secrets to unveil
[*]     Bartending-action: serve your maiden of choice liquor, in order to dive deeper into the dungeon.
[*]     Lots of custom actions and animations in battles focused on protection and strategy
[*]     Try to trigger the spirit-maiden's "Potential" to annihilate your enemies in a swoop!
[*]     Mysticards: collect, use and equip magical cards to power up your party in any way you see fit
[/list]

A free uncensor patch is up on our website as well. Happy dungeon crawling!

notes.title: Uncensor Patch & Guide To Install
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,

Thanks to cooperation with the developer and one our players, we were able to get an uncensor patch coordinated and released.

Please note that this contains sexual content and is not suitable for minors under the age of 18.

The patch can be downloaded from here:
http://tophatentertainment.us/patches/Game.rgssad

After downloading, find the Steam base folder, then "steamapps", then "common", then finally, "Girls and Dungeons". Select the downloaded file and move it to this directory, overwriting the existing file.

This should be all that is needed.

If you have any questions (or just want to chat), join our Discord:
https://discord.gg/Qphynem

or follow us on social media for updates:
